description: The Symphony by Imtiaz presents a distinctive vision of contemporary luxury, where sculptural architecture, fluid forms, and refined design come together in a harmonious residential concept. Inspired by the architectural philosophy associated with Zaha Hadid, the development embraces expressive curves, geometric precision, and the interplay of light and shadow to create a striking architectural presence. Every element reflects a considered balance between artistic expression and everyday functionality, offering a sophisticated living environment shaped by design and tranquillity. Residences and interiors The residential collection includes elegant 1-bedroom apartments, spacious duplex residences, and refined master suites. Interiors are designed around natural textures, soft lighting, and seamless transitions between living spaces, creating an atmosphere of openness and calm. Open-plan kitchens connect effortlessly with living and dining areas, while private balconies extend the living experience outdoors, framing views of the surrounding cityscape. Thoughtfully planned layouts maximise space and functionality while maintaining the development's distinctive design language. The result is a contemporary home environment where architectural character meets comfort and understated elegance. Amenities and lifestyle The Symphony offers a curated range of amenities designed to support wellness, relaxation, and social connection. The clubhouse features inviting lounge areas, billiards, and a dedicated reading corner, providing comfortable spaces for leisure and interaction. The fitness studio is equipped for mindful movement and full-body training, while the landscaped podium garden introduces a tranquil green retreat within the development. Rooftop and social spaces provide additional settings for relaxation, gathering, and enjoying the surrounding views. Across these shared spaces, thoughtful design and natural elements contribute to an atmosphere of contemporary sophistication. Finishes and smart-home features The interiors combine modern aesthetics with high-quality materials and carefully selected international brands. Bathrooms feature sanitaryware by Villeroy & Boch, technical solutions from Geberit, and designer fittings by Gessi, adding a refined touch to everyday routines. Kitchens and household areas may include appliances from leading brands such as Bosch and Samsung. Smart-home features integrated with Alexa offer added convenience, supporting a more seamless and connected living experience. Together, these details reinforce the development's emphasis on quality, functionality, and considered design. Location and lifestyle Located in Meydan City, The Symphony benefits from a prestigious Dubai address that combines contemporary residential living with open spaces and access to major city destinations. The area is known for the iconic Meydan Racecourse, home to the renowned Dubai World Cup, which brings international attention and a distinctive sporting atmosphere to the neighbourhood. Meydan City also features landscaped gardens, parks, and tree-lined streets, offering opportunities for outdoor recreation, walking, cycling, and community activities. These green spaces provide a welcome contrast to Dubai's dynamic urban environment. With road connections to key destinations across Dubai, Meydan offers access to business districts, shopping venues, dining destinations, and entertainment options. Its combination of modern infrastructure, recreational surroundings, and a prominent address makes it an appealing location for residents seeking a balance between city convenience and a more tranquil residential setting. The Symphony brings together expressive architecture, premium interior details, and thoughtfully designed lifestyle amenities to create a distinctive residential experience in Meydan City.

These terms can make the purchase structure worth exploring, although eligibility and current availability should be confirmed before booking.

For investors, the appeal lies in assessing the complete proposition: Dubai Islands as a coastal location, the development's limited scale, the specification of the residences, and the payment terms available at the time of purchase.

Explore the available layouts, compare the total acquisition costs, and decide whether this coastal address fits your investment strategy. Future rental returns and capital appreciation are not guaranteed, so the numbers should always be reviewed carefully.

description: Maybach Ultimate Luxury is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. The project features two striking towers, each comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, and an elegant residential structure - with nineteen floors in Tower A and twenty-five in Tower B. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Every detail is curated to reflect understated luxury and timeless style. Residents are treated to an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities, including a stunning infinity swimming pool, a shared jacuzzi, and dedicated outdoor yoga spaces. The development also features beautifully designed leisure and relaxation areas, premium beauty salons, diverse dining outlets, and well-equipped sports facilities. Complemented by valet parking and professional concierge services, every detail is thoughtfully curated to provide comfort, convenience, and elevated everyday living. The residential component features a refined collection of luxury towers designed to reflect the innovation, performance, and sophistication associated with the Mercedes-Benz brand. Homes are envisioned as contemporary urban sanctuaries, offering elegant layouts, expansive views, and a strong connection to the surrounding cityscape. Premium materials, meticulous detailing, and high-quality finishes define both interiors and common areas, creating a living environment where luxury, precision, and timeless design converge. Location description and benefits Meydan is one of Dubai's most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan's master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

title: WHY WAIT WHEN YOU CAN OWN READY?
raw_area: Azizi Riviera 66, Azizi Riviera, Meydan One, Meydan, Dubai
description:
A property purchase should be about more than an attractive brochure. It should be about the actual home, the community around it, and how well the property fits your financial and lifestyle goals.

Explore a ready-to-move-in apartment in a completed building within a major residential community in Meydan, Dubai. Instead of waiting for construction to finish, you can inspect the unit, review its condition, understand the building's service charges, and compare its price with similar available properties before making your decision.

The community's appeal comes from its Mediterranean-inspired atmosphere, lagoon-side setting, swimming pools, fitness facilities, landscaped spaces, walking and jogging routes, and retail promenade with cafés and restaurants. Its road connections to Downtown Dubai and Business Bay add to the location's appeal for residents who want access to key business and lifestyle destinations.

If you plan to live in the apartment, you can focus on the layout, natural light, outlook, building facilities, and convenience of the location. If you are buying for investment, you can evaluate current asking rents, comparable leased units, ongoing costs, and the potential demand for your specific apartment. A ready property may offer the opportunity to pursue rental income sooner than an off-plan purchase, but actual returns depend on the purchase price, occupancy, expenses, and market conditions.

For buyers who value clarity and the ability to assess a real property before committing, a completed apartment offers a practical starting point.

Don't buy only for what a project promises tomorrow. Consider what the property can offer you today.

The surrounding area benefits from its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, and major road networks connecting different parts of the emirate. These destinations contribute to the area's long-term development potential and accessibility. Residents can also reach shopping, dining, entertainment, and everyday facilities across nearby communities. With its growing infrastructure, strategic connectivity, and proximity to major development zones in southern Dubai, Dubai Industrial City offers an interesting residential and investment location. Mirari Lagoon brings together modern furnished apartments, leisure facilities, and convenient access to key destinations, creating a contemporary living option within this developing part of Dubai.

raw_area: 885F+6F - Nakhlat Deira - Dubai Islands - Dubai - United Arab Emirates, Dubai, Dubai
description: Project general facts This is a premium waterfront residential development rising on Dubai Islands, where contemporary architecture meets the calm rhythm of the sea. Designed with refined coastal tones and fluid façades, the project reflects a modern interpretation of island living, defined by openness, light, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Low-density planning enhances privacy and exclusivity, while landscaped gardens and open lounges create a resort-style ambiance shaped by nature and horizon views. The lifestyle is centered around wellness, leisure, and effortless sophistication. Residents are welcomed through a dedicated VIP drop-off area and enjoy access to an extensive collection of curated amenities, including adult and children's swimming pools, a pavilion clubhouse, outdoor yoga and wellness zones, jogging and walking tracks, mixed landscape gardens with sand and gravel concepts, grand tiered seating areas, covered lounges, and open-to-sky garden seating. From cascading water features to outdoor cinema and relaxation decks, every space is designed to evoke a refined island retreat atmosphere. The residences are delivered fully furnished and fully designed, incorporating a smart home system and refined interior detailing accessorized by Hermès. Layouts are bright and airy, emphasizing natural light and a smooth transition between interior and exterior spaces. Duplex residences feature elevated privacy and, in select units, private pools, enhancing the exclusive waterfront experience. Sea Cliff by Imtiaz represents a harmonious blend of architectural elegance, intelligent living, and curated luxury in a serene island setting. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities. title: Dubai Islands, Dubai
description: Isla Private Residences is a boutique waterfront development on Dubai Islands by Chaimaa Holding, conceived around the philosophy of Dolce Far Niente - the art of refined, intentional living. The project comprises an exclusive collection of 76 one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences, defined by sculptural architecture, flowing terraces, and expansive glazing that frames open sea and skyline views. The building's elegant curves, landscaped podium, and expressive rooftop silhouette create a distinctive presence within the coastal destination of Dubai Islands. The development offers 32 amenities curated across three dedicated lifestyle levels, thoughtfully divided into family, wellness, social, and entertainment experiences. Highlights include a Sanctuary Pool and dedicated children's splash areas, a salt sauna and cold plunge pool for contrast therapy, and a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the sea. Social spaces extend beyond traditional lounges, featuring asunken seating with a fireplace, communal dining terraces, and an outdoor cinema. A rooftop sports lounge and bar, secret garden zones, yoga terraces, and a dedicated entertainment lounge for teens and young adults add a distinctive layer of community-focused living rarely seen in boutique projects on Dubai Islands. Interiors are designed with an emphasis on light, proportion, and refined materiality. Floor-to-ceiling windows enhance openness and natural illumination, while contemporary kitchens integrate premium appliances and generous worktops to balance aesthetics with practicality. Bathrooms are conceived as spa-inspired environments, featuring upscale fittings and sophisticated materials that elevate everyday rituals. Each residence includes dedicated utility areas and private balconies, reinforcing seamless indoor-outdoor living and a sense of tranquil coastal retreat. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.

description: Project general facts New Project is an elegant mixed-use residential tower that blends contemporary architecture with a warm, welcoming sense of home. Its refined facade of soft cream stone, bronze-toned vertical fins and gently curved edges gives the building a graceful and instantly recognisable silhouette. Life at the tower centres on a beautifully landscaped podium deck with a sparkling swimming pool, comfortable sunloungers, a shaded cabana and relaxed lounge seating surrounded by lush greenery. A bright, fully equipped gym with floor-to-ceiling glass overlooks the pool, making every workout feel energising and inspiring. Every home is designed to feel light and open, with expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the interiors with natural daylight. Private balconies with sleek glass balustrades extend the living space outdoors and create a perfect spot to unwind. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Project general facts Ice Beach by Major Developments at Marjan Beach is a stunning waterfront development that perfectly blends modern architecture with a resort-inspired lifestyle. The project offers a diverse selection of residences, including one-bedroom apartments in Mini, Standard, and Luxury layouts, two-bedroom homes available in Standard and spacious Duplex configurations, elegant three-bedroom apartments, and exclusive Sky Villas for those seeking ultimate privacy and prestige. Each home is carefully designed to provide breathtaking views, abundant natural light, and a refined yet comfortable living experience. Residents will enjoy access to premium amenities that transform everyday living into a five-star retreat. The private beach club creates an exclusive seaside atmosphere, offering a peaceful escape just steps from home. Spectacular swimming pools, leisure decks, wellness facilities, and entertainment areas are all thoughtfully integrated to deliver relaxation, fun, and sophistication in one vibrant destination. All residences will be delivered fully furnished, allowing homeowners to move in effortlessly and immediately enjoy their new space. The kitchens come fully equipped with high-quality appliances, combining modern design with everyday practicality. Premium materials, elegant finishes, and carefully selected details throughout each unit create a stylish, contemporary ambiance that reflects true luxury living. Location description and benefits Marjan Beach is one of the most desirable coastal destinations in the emirate, offering residents a serene waterfront lifestyle framed by the calm waters of the Arabian Gulf. Located within the iconic Al Marjan Island, the beach combines natural beauty with carefully planned infrastructure and a refined resort atmosphere. Soft white sands, crystal-clear waters, and beautifully maintained promenades create a setting that feels both exclusive and welcoming. It is a place where everyday life unfolds against a backdrop of open sea views and refreshing coastal breezes. For residents, Marjan Beach offers a harmonious balance between relaxation and activity. Morning walks along the shoreline, sunset yoga sessions, and water sports become part of a healthy, inspiring routine. The area is surrounded by upscale resorts, charming cafés, and leisure attractions, all within easy reach yet thoughtfully integrated to preserve tranquility. The environment is clean, secure, and designed to provide comfort throughout the year. Living by Marjan Beach means enjoying a resort-style lifestyle without leaving home. The community atmosphere is peaceful and family-friendly, making it ideal for both full-time residents and holiday homeowners. Expansive sea views and open horizons create a sense of space and freedom that is increasingly rare. It is a destination that continues to grow in prestige, offering long-term value alongside an exceptional quality of life.

description: Laguna Residence is a distinctive residential development that reimagines contemporary living through an innovative lagoon-inspired concept. Designed to bring the tranquillity of waterfront living into an urban environment, the project features the UAE's largest podium lagoon, creating a resort-style atmosphere where relaxation, recreation, and modern sophistication come together. With its unique architectural vision and nature-inspired surroundings, Laguna Residence offers a refreshing lifestyle that balances the energy of city living with the serenity of a private retreat. Smart home technology enhances everyday convenience, while equipped kitchens and intelligently planned layouts create functional and elegant living spaces. Laguna Residence elevates modern living through technology-driven features and an extensive collection of more than 30 indoor and outdoor amenities. Location Description and Benefits Situated in City of Arabia, within the wider Dubailand district, Laguna Residence is part of an evolving mixed-use destination planned to bring residential, commercial, retail, and leisure experiences together. Its master-planned concept emphasizes convenience, with opportunities for shopping, dining, recreation, and everyday activities within the wider district. City of Arabia is associated with major leisure and retail concepts, including the planned Mall of Arabia and the Restless Planet attraction. As development progresses, the district aims to offer residents a broader selection of retail, dining, and family-oriented experiences, adding to its potential appeal as a residential destination. The wider Dubailand area benefits from road connections to other parts of Dubai, while ongoing development continues to shape its residential and commercial landscape. Planned infrastructure and leisure destinations contribute to the area's long-term vision, although individual projects and transport links may progress in phases. For buyers and investors, Laguna Residence offers a distinctive proposition through its signature lagoon concept, contemporary residences, and extensive amenities within an emerging urban community.

description: Luxury Apartments in DIFC Zabeel with Resort Style Amenities Located in DIFC Zabeel, Dubai, these apartments are a part of the prestigious expansion of Dubai International Financial Centre. The area enjoys a highly strategic location within one of the city's most connected and sought-after urban environments. Within the area, residents benefit from easy access to major highways, public transport links, and the vibrant business and lifestyle ecosystem. The area has been masterplanned to create a walkable, integrated community that combines premium residential living with commercial, retail, and leisure components. In terms of connectivity, these are just minutes from key landmarks such as DIFC Gate District and the Museum of the Future, about 10-15 minutes from Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall, approximately 15 minutes from Dubai International Airport (DXB), and around 20 minutes from Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina, depending on traffic conditions. The project distinguishes itself through a hospitality-inspired lifestyle concept supported by extensive social amenities. The project includes resort-style swimming pools, dedicated fitness and wellness facilities, landscaped green spaces including a 2 km inner walking loop, and sports courts such as padel and squash. Social lounges, co-working areas, and curated retail and dining outlets further enhance the sense of community. Choosing to purchase an apartment from this project means securing a home in a prime live-work-play destination, where high professional demand, limited central land supply, and long-term urban planning contribute to sustained value and desirability. More broadly, acquiring property in Dubai offers a combination of investment potential and elevated lifestyle. The city's global connectivity, strong rental market in prime areas, and reputation for safety and infrastructure continue to attract international buyers. A centrally located luxury apartment not only provides access to a refined urban lifestyle but also positions owners to benefit from long-term capital appreciation and consistent rental demand in one of the world's most dynamic real estate markets. description:
IT'S 6 PM. YOU'RE FINALLY HOME.

But you didn't just enter an apartment building. You entered a resort.

Your kids run straight to the lagoon pool, laughing. The water is warm, perfect. You wave to your neighbor at the BBQ deck — he's grilling, music low, sunset over the podium gardens.

You skip the traffic to the gym. Why would you go anywhere else? Your gym is downstairs. Fully equipped. Next to it, your wife is in the Aerial Yoga studio, finally getting that hour for herself.

Later, you take your dog to his own park. Yes, he has a park. Then a quick jog on the track surrounded by 500 trees. You breathe. This is Arjan, but it doesn't feel like Dubai. It feels like a private escape.

Upstairs, your laptop is open in the co-working space. You just recorded a podcast in your building's private studio. Your client thinks you rented a studio downtown.

Your friends ask, "Where do you live again?"
You smile. "Arjan. Next to Miracle Garden. 10 minutes from everything, but far from the noise."

They look at your photos. The Family Lagoon. The half-Olympic pool. The co-working lounge. The retail arcade right at your door.

They ask, "How much did this cost?"

You smile again. Because you bought it before everyone else realized — *Arjan is not the future. It's the smart money right now.*

*This isn't a property. It's the moment your life got an upgrade.*

*16 resort amenities. One private address. Limited units left.*

description:
Imagine yourself living here...

Imagine opening your eyes and your balcony isn't a balcony. It's a private garden in the sky. Green plants wrapped around you, a big wicker egg chair, and soft fairy lights tangled in the leaves. No noise. No traffic. Just green, quiet, like you're in a resort.

You walk inside... It's fully furnished, premium finishes, everything is done. You walk into the bathroom and you feel like you walked into a spa. Marble, hidden LED glow under the sink, a big mirror, and a calm vibe that makes you forget you're in an apartment.

You go downstairs... The swimming pool is not a building pool, it's a resort. Sun deck, a cabana with woven pendant lights and golden glow, lit palm trees, and a space where you can sit with your family like you're on vacation every day.

Want to work out? The gym is not just a gym. It's floor-to-ceiling glass with the whole city in front of you, brand new equipment, and a quiet yoga area where you can breathe away from the world. Your kids have their own safe, closed play zone.

And at night? It's a whole different story. The pool glows blue, your balcony is full of golden lights, and the entire Dubai skyline lights up in front of you. Marina and JBR glowing in the background like you're watching a movie.

And the best part? You're in Al Furjan. That means the metro is at your doorstep. Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road are 2 minutes away. Marina is 10 minutes, Ibn Battuta Mall is 5 minutes, and all your work, schools, and life are around you. It's the most in-demand rental area in Dubai right now. Everyone wants to live here.

So whether you live in it and feel that resort life every day... or you rent it out and get a high rental yield because everyone is looking for this area... you win.

This is not an apartment... This is a full resort life, with interest-free installments, pre-launch prices, and limited units.

*Imagine yourself living it... before someone else takes it.*

The Quayside is a premium residential project by Ellington Properties, ideally located in Business Bay, Dubai. Nearby communities include District One with its Crystal Lagoon, City Walk, DIFC, Meydan, The Polo Residence, and the beachfront La Mer.

The Quayside offers a refined lifestyle combining comfort, prestige, and stunning canal views, making it an excellent choice for both end-users and investors seeking prime property in Dubai.

description: Volta by DAMAC Properties is a premium residential development situated in the heart of Downtown Dubai, offering an exceptional blend of contemporary architecture, urban sophistication, and upscale living. The development features a diverse collection of one- and two-bedroom apartments alongside super-luxury three- and four-bedroom residences, catering to a range of lifestyle preferences. Designed to complement Dubai's dynamic cityscape, the tower combines elegant residential spaces with modern functionality, further enhanced by a dedicated 13-storey podium parking structure for added convenience. The development offers a thoughtfully curated lifestyle with dedicated recreational spaces and leisure amenities, including a rooftop amenity area atop the separate podium parking structure. Its prime Downtown Dubai location places residents within easy reach of prestigious shopping destinations, fine dining establishments, entertainment venues, and renowned cultural landmarks. This combination of urban connectivity, premium facilities, and contemporary residential design creates an appealing living environment for those seeking a sophisticated city lifestyle. The interiors are finished with carefully selected materials and contemporary detailing to create a refined and functional living experience. Living and dining areas feature elegant marble flooring, painted walls, and selected accent finishes, while bedrooms incorporate porcelain tile flooring, built-in wardrobes, and thoughtfully designed feature walls in the master bedroom. Bathrooms are appointed with stone countertops, quality sanitary ware, mirrors, shower enclosures, and modern fittings. Kitchens feature sleek cabinetry, stone countertops, stainless-steel sinks, porcelain flooring, and integrated appliances, including a cooker, extractor hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. Delivered unfurnished, the residences provide a premium finished foundation that allows homeowners to personalise their interiors according to their individual tastes. Location Description and Benefits Downtown Dubai is one of the city's most prestigious and vibrant destinations, renowned for its iconic skyline, world-class attractions, and cosmopolitan atmosphere. Home to celebrated landmarks such as Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the spectacular Dubai Fountain, the district offers an exceptional combination of luxury shopping, fine dining, entertainment, and cultural experiences. Its dynamic environment attracts residents and visitors throughout the year, making it one of Dubai's most recognisable lifestyle and residential destinations. The neighbourhood offers a sophisticated urban lifestyle, with an extensive selection of luxury residences, premium hotels, stylish cafés, and high-end leisure destinations. Beyond its commercial appeal, Downtown Dubai provides a vibrant residential environment where everyday conveniences and entertainment are seamlessly integrated. From designer boutiques and international restaurants to scenic promenades and lively public spaces, the district caters to those who appreciate a connected and contemporary way of living. Strategically positioned near Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), Al Wasl, and Business Bay, Downtown Dubai benefits from excellent connectivity to key commercial districts, residential communities, and major destinations across the city. Its accessible transport links and proximity to essential amenities make it particularly attractive to professionals, frequent travellers, and residents seeking convenient urban living. Combining a prestigious address, landmark surroundings, and a thriving lifestyle scene, Downtown Dubai continues to stand out as one of the city's most desirable destinations for luxury residential living.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Luxurious Sea-View Flats with Private Beach Access on Dubai Islands The development is located within Dubai Islands, a premium waterfront destination off the coast of Deira, designed to offer beachside living with convenient access to the mainland. Dubai Islands combines the heritage charm of old Dubai with a modern coastal lifestyle, creating a unique environment where residents can enjoy sea views, sandy beaches, and a growing hospitality-driven master community. Its island setting provides a resort atmosphere while remaining well-connected to the city. In terms of connectivity, flats for sale in Dubai Islands are approximately 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport (DXB) and around 2425 minutes from Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall, depending on traffic. Palm Jumeirah can typically be reached in about 3540 minutes, while JBR and Dubai Marina are roughly 40 minutes away. This balance between island privacy and city accessibility enhances both lifestyle comfort and rental appeal. The project follows a low-rise boutique concept (generally structured as G+2P+8) with a limited number of flats, emphasizing privacy and exclusivity. A defining feature is its climate-controlled sunken balconies and winter garden concept, designed to allow year-round use of outdoor spaces. Social amenities include an infinity swimming pool with a leisure deck, a jacuzzi, a childrens pool and play areas, a fully equipped gym, yoga space, outdoor cinema, BBQ areas, landscaped relaxation zones, hammock garden, and a community garden. Buyers are drawn to the Dubai Islands because it offers a rare combination of beachfront living, limited supply, and strong future growth potential within a master-planned island destination. From an investment and lifestyle perspective, purchasing property in Dubai offers access to a globally recognized real estate market that combines modern infrastructure, safety, and high living standards. The city supports foreign ownership in designated areas and regulates off-plan developments through escrow systems designed to protect buyers. A waterfront residence in an emerging island community, therefore, presents both a luxury living experience and long-term investment potential in one of the worlds most dynamic property markets. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. description: Reference: GTWW-T1356. The building is located in the heart of Downtown Dubai, in one of the city's most prestigious locations, close to urban landmarks and with easy access to major thoroughfares and business, retail and leisure centres. The architecture is distinguished by its imposing silhouette, with a glazed façade and modern lines, creating a striking presence in the urban skyline and offering privileged visual amplitudes, with floor-to-ceiling windows that maximise the entry of natural light and frame spectacular views of the city. The residential typologies available range from studios to three-bedroom apartments, also encompassing 1 and 2-bedroom apartments all designed with contemporary layouts, refined finishes and high standards of comfort. In addition to traditional residences, some premium units include special features such as jacuzzis, lap pools, balconies/terraces and large windows that provide direct views of the urban skyline or canal/water areas of the city. The set of amenities and services complements the notion of a luxury residence: residents will have access to an infinity pool at the top, a modern gym with city views, wellness and spa areas, elevated green areas (hanging gardens or 'sky gardens'), living spaces, children's areas, secure parking, concierge service, 24/7 security and controlled access. Some higher-category apartments benefit from additional comfort elements such as private pools directly in the units (or on their terraces), providing exclusivity and privacy in one of Dubai's most desirable areas. The construction scheme is organised with several floors: underground, support/podium floors, residential floors and technical mechanisms, offering a total of dozens of floors for housing, with a limited number of units, which contributes to the exclusivity of the development. This project was designed for those looking to live in the city centre with its pace, conveniences and services without giving up comfort, luxury and privileged views. title: Old Town, Umm al-Quwain
description: Modern Waterfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a natural sanctuary renowned for its unspoiled white sand beaches, clear blue waters, and rich biodiversity, including mangroves that provide habitat for species such as flamingos, turtles, oryxes, and gazelles. The island holds historical significance as the oldest pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf and is home to an ancient Eastern Christian monastery, reflecting its vibrant past. Recent developments aim to transform Siniyah Island into a premier destination, blending luxury living with ecological preservation while maintaining its cultural heritage. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 5 minutes from essential services, 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project is situated in a stunning island setting, blending refined waterfront elegance and lush natural beauty. Its exterior showcases contemporary architectural brilliance seamlessly integrated with serene sea views, sun-drenched promenades, and a dynamic marina. The residences boast direct access to a motorized seawater body, a yacht club with mooring facilities, and a lively promenade enriched by fine dining, boutique cafés, and vibrant nightlife. Residents enjoy podium-level infinity pools, cutting-edge fitness centers with marina views, cozy lounges, and engaging outdoor play zones. Expansive landscaped gardens and parks add to the tranquil setting, while a luxury hotel and a high-end mall offer indulgence and convenience. Additional features include a fully operational golf course, helipad, exclusive resorts, and seamless pedestrian connectivity via a scenic bridge, all thoughtfully designed to elevate coastal living into a lifestyle of refined leisure and adventure. The project presents a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, where modern design meets exceptional functionality across three residential towers. Tower C offers fully furnished units, offering a sophisticated turnkey solution with elegant furniture, fitted wardrobes, and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods for a seamless move-in experience. Towers A and B are semi-furnished, featuring the same premium built-in wardrobes and fully fitted kitchens, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces while enjoying core conveniences. Interiors are spacious and light-filled, enhanced by thoughtfully curated layouts, en-suite bathrooms, powder rooms, and private balconies that frame serene views of the marina, park, or sea. Every detail has been crafted to reflect contemporary coastal elegance, offering residents a perfect balance between luxurious comfort and everyday practicality. UAQ-00010

description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Additionally, thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating water sports such as scuba diving, snorkeling, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. The retail boulevard offers a sensory feast with charming cafes and gourmet dining, enhancing the vibrant community atmosphere. Exclusive services such as a yacht club, a shopping mall, luxury resorts, and a helipad further elevate the sophisticated lifestyle experience provided by this prestigious island residence. raw_area: Distrikt at Ghaf Woods, Ghaf Woods, Dubai
description:
WHEN THE FOREST BECOMES PART OF YOUR EVERYDAY LIFE

Imagine waking up in Dubai...

Not to the sound of traffic, not to concrete stretching endlessly across the horizon, but to a different kind of morning — one surrounded by trees, fresh air and the quiet feeling that nature is finally part of your everyday life.

This is the story of Lyra at Ghaf Woods.

Set within one of Dubai's most distinctive forest-inspired communities, Lyra introduces a new way of experiencing urban living. Here, your home doesn't simply stand within a neighbourhood. It becomes part of a landscape designed around greenery, movement, wellbeing and connection.

Step inside your residence and the feeling continues.

Contemporary interiors open towards natural light, creating a calm and elegant setting where the outside world feels beautifully close. Whether you choose a one- or two-bedroom residence, the spaces are designed for modern life while keeping a sense of warmth and privacy.

Then, instead of taking the elevator down into another concrete cityscape, you step outside into something different.

Walk beneath the trees.

Take your morning run along the trails.

Cycle through the landscape.

Pause beside the forest pools.

Let the children discover their own world through nature gardens and outdoor spaces, while you find a quiet moment for yourself at the wellness and yoga pavilion.

At Ghaf Woods, nature is not decoration.

It is the lifestyle.

And when you want to reconnect with the energy of Dubai, the city remains within easy reach, with Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road nearby.

Lyra is for those who want a home that feels different the moment they arrive — a place where mornings are calmer, evenings feel lighter and everyday life has room to breathe.

Because sometimes, the greatest luxury in a city like Dubai isn't being closer to everything.

It's having a place where you can finally slow down.

description: A home you can arrive at, unpack and immediately feel away from everything. Residents will have access to a swimming pool, children's pool, outdoor gym, barbecue area, landscaped spaces, seating areas and a concierge lobby. Then there is the setting itself. title: Lagoon-Facing 1-Bed Apartment at Claydon House
description:
A stunning one-bedroom home with lagoon views to one side and Downtown Dubai on the horizon - this mid-floor apartment at Claydon House offers a serene and compelling proposition. Part of Ellington’s Meydan Horizon community, it features two bathrooms, a smart open-plan layout, and a genuine sense of resort-style living, ideal for anyone looking for space, light, and picturesque views without stepping into a villa-sized budget.

The Tour

The building’s interiors strike an impression from the moment you enter the reception doors. Claydon House has a lobby dressed in warm taupe and grey marble. Sculptural open shelving, soft sofas and marble-topped coffee tables sit to either side, all creating a polished, hotel-like feel before the lift takes you up to the residences.

Inside, the kitchen and living area flow together as one open, light-filled space. Two-tone grey and oak cabinetry surround a marble island with seating and a round dining table sits just beyond, framed by tall windows that draw the daylight straight in. The living area opens directly towards Downtown Dubai, while the relaxing balcony gives glimpses of the evergreen views across Meydan.


The Area

Meydan Horizon sits within the wider Meydan district - a community planned around lush green waterways and a genuine sense of resort living. Crystal lagoons and a waterfront promenade become a part of everyday life, with Downtown Dubai and the wider skyline visible across.

Claydon House provides direct access to the lagoon and offers amenities including an infinity pool, adult lap pool, fitness and yoga facilities, library, cinema, co-working spaces and children’s play areas. Business Bay and DIFC are all within reach.

What We Like

• The lagoon and skyline view

• Resort-style amenities

• Quick access to Downtown Dubai and Business Bay

description:
Some places are built around buildings. Others are designed around the way you want to live.

In the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a contemporary European-inspired community rises with a different idea of urban living — one where architecture, greenery and everyday experiences come together to create a place that feels beautifully complete.

Imagine waking up to generous natural light, stepping onto your private terrace and beginning the day with your own quiet view of the community. The gym opens onto an outdoor area created for yoga, Pilates and moments of stillness, while the multifunctional paddle court adds energy whenever you feel like moving.

Families have their own rhythm too, with a spacious kids club and outdoor cinema designed to give children a world of their own.

And then there is the rooftop.

For the select penthouses, expansive terraces and private swimming pools transform the highest levels into a more exclusive expression of life above the city. Here, the skyline becomes your backdrop, the terrace becomes your private outdoor room, and every sunset feels like an occasion.

With contemporary architecture, high ceilings, landscaped surroundings, concierge services and a location connected to Dubai's major roads and destinations, The Orchard Place brings together the things that matter most: space, comfort, connection and a sense of belonging.

title: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai
raw_area: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai, Dubai
description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. Contact: Mayank

Expo City Dubai offers a perfect blend of tranquility and excitement, making it an exceptional choice for those seeking a unique urban lifestyle in Dubai.

The Type 1 plan separates the bedroom from a combined living-and-dining room, then adds a dressing area, full bathroom and guest powder room. The arrival is deliberately composed. A guest powder room sits close to the entrance, allowing the private side of the suite to remain separate when entertaining. Beyond it, the living-and-dining room forms the social centre of the accommodation, with the balcony extending across the curved outer façade. The bedroom occupies its own zone and is supported by a dedicated dressing area and full bathroom. Both principal rooms are positioned against the balcony line, making the outdoor space and high-floor outlook central to the plan. The brochure identifies an approximately 4.2 by 4.4 metre living-and-dining room, a 3.8 by 5.0 metre bedroom, a 2.1 by 2.9 metre dressing area, a 4.0 by 2.3 metre bathroom and a 2.3 by 1.3 metre powder room. The balcony measures approximately 4.9 by 10.7 metres. At nearly 50 m², this outdoor area is a defining part of the Executive Suite rather than a token terrace. Dimensions are indicative and remain subject to the selected sale documents. This is a hotel suite, not a conventional self-catering apartment. The supplied plan includes a dining setting within the combined living room but shows no private kitchen and no separate dining room. Buyers should assess it on that basis: the accommodation prioritises a proper lounge, bedroom privacy, dressing space, two washroom functions and exceptional outdoor scale, while dining is delivered through the wider hotel environment. Project visuals propose a calm, polished interior language of warm timber, pale stone, tailored lighting and broad glazing. The separation between the social and private zones gives the suite a measured residential rhythm without losing its five-star hotel identity. Visuals communicate the intended design direction only; finishes, furniture, equipment and operating provisions must be verified against the contractual specification. The hotel amenity programme includes a rooftop swimming pool and pool bar, specialty restaurant, spa and sauna, gymnasium, business lounge and grand ballroom. A padel court, children's club and play areas, children's pool, outdoor cinema and barbecue areas extend the setting across leisure, wellness, business and family stays. RAK Central places the hotel between Ras Al Khaimah's commercial centre and its resort corridor. Al Hamra Mall is approximately five minutes away, Al Hamra Golf Club seven minutes away, Al Marjan Island eight minutes away and Wynn Al Marjan Island around ten minutes away. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is approximately fifteen minutes away, while Dubai International Airport is around forty-five minutes away. Drive times are indicative and depend on traffic. For an international buyer, the Executive Suite occupies the collection's deliberate middle position: the privacy of a genuine one-bedroom, the Hotel's highest floor for this layout and far more outdoor space than the Studio, without moving into the larger Presidential configuration. description: VERDAN1A 4 is a contemporary residential development located in Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), designed to bring together modern architecture, nature-inspired surroundings, and sustainable urban living. Offering a diverse selection of studios, 1, 2, 2.5, and 3.5-bedroom apartments, the development caters to a wide range of lifestyle requirements, from individuals and young professionals to growing families. Its architectural concept emphasizes a harmonious relationship between modern structures and landscaped green spaces, creating a residential environment focused on comfort, wellness, and everyday convenience. The development offers a thoughtfully designed collection of lifestyle amenities that encourage relaxation, recreation, and community engagement. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool with a sun deck, a dedicated children's pool, a fully equipped gymnasium, and a welcoming clubhouse. Additional facilities include a children's playroom, outdoor BBQ areas, and a landscaped terrace garden, providing spaces for social gatherings, family activities, and peaceful moments. The combination of indoor and outdoor amenities creates a well-rounded residential experience for residents of all ages. The interiors reflect a contemporary design philosophy, featuring elegant finishes, carefully selected materials, and functional layouts that maximize comfort and usability. Each residence includes an equipped kitchen with modern appliances, offering convenience for everyday living. Apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors according to their individual preferences while benefiting from thoughtfully planned spaces and refined contemporary detailing. Location Description & Benefits Located within Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), VERDAN1A 4 enjoys a position in one of Dubai's evolving residential communities, known for its growing selection of modern developments, family-friendly surroundings, and convenient access to essential lifestyle facilities. The area offers a balance between residential comfort and urban connectivity, making it an attractive destination for both homeowners and investors. DLRC benefits from connectivity to major road networks, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road, providing convenient access to key destinations across the city. Residents can reach established areas such as Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, and Motor City, while Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport are accessible through the wider road network. The surrounding area offers a growing range of retail outlets, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, educational institutions, and healthcare facilities, ensuring that everyday requirements are conveniently accessible. Its proximity to major family entertainment destinations, including Dubai Parks and Resorts, further enhances the area's recreational appeal, offering attractions such as LEGOLAND, MOTIONGATE Dubai, and LEGOLAND Water Park. The wider Dubailand district also provides access to various outdoor and sporting facilities, including parks, cycling routes, fitness destinations, and recreational spaces that support an active lifestyle. As the surrounding residential and commercial infrastructure continues to develop, DLRC is gaining attention as an emerging residential destination within Dubai. With its diverse apartment configurations, nature-inspired design, family-oriented amenities, and convenient connectivity, VERDAN1A 4 presents an appealing residential opportunity for end-users seeking comfortable modern living and investors exploring Dubai's growing residential communities.

description: Branded Luxury Apartments with Installments in Downtown Dubai Downtown Dubai is the city's vibrant flagship district, renowned for its iconic landmarks, world-class lifestyle, and unmatched investment appeal. Home to the majestic Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall, and the captivating Dubai Fountain, it offers a perfect blend of luxury living, entertainment, and cultural experiences. With its premium residential towers, fine dining venues, designer boutiques, and direct connectivity to major business hubs, Downtown Dubai stands as the ultimate address for those seeking prestige, convenience, and a dynamic urban lifestyle. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street, 4 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 7 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 10 minutes from Dubai Opera, 12 minutes from Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. Rising 71 stories above Dubai's iconic Sheikh Zayed Road, this architectural masterpiece is shaped as a gently curving prism inspired by desert winds, creating a striking landmark on the city skyline. Designed by the award-winning firm Arquitectonica with interiors by 1508 London, it blends minimalist sophistication with refined Italian elegance. raw_area: 67JW+P2W - Za'abeel - Al Kifaf - Dubai - United Arab Emirates, Dubai, Dubai
description: We offer for sale a 2-room apartment with a rental contract, with an area of 88 m² , in the popular Zabeel area. The apartment is located in the new residential complex 1 Residences. It is fully renovated and equipped with furniture and appliances. The offered apartment is on a high floor, with a well-thought-out and convenient layout, a spacious balcony, and panoramic views of the park. The bright interior is designed in a modern style in cool tones with marble and tiles. The apartment has 1 parking space in the underground garage. Starting price - EUR 585,830. There is currently an annual rental contract with monthly payments. The current return is 5-6% per year. There is potential to increase profitability by renting the apartment short-term. About the project 1 Residences is a complex of two original towers in the shape of the number "1" in the historic district of Bur Dubai. The 43-storey buildings are elegantly connected at the top levels by a skybridge. Construction of the project was completed in 2022. Infrastructure On the podium level of the complex and the top three floors, public areas with landscaping and premium amenities have been created for residents and guests of 1 Residences. These include swimming pools with lounge areas, fountains, children's playgrounds, a modern gym, a 340-meter running track on the 43rd floor, and much more. The 1 Residences complex is located in Al Kifaf, near Dubai's popular historic district of Bur Dubai. The area includes many historic sites: the Dubai Museum in 18th-century style, the historic Al Bastakiya quarter, and more. The active residence of the Emir of Dubai, Zabeel Palace, is also located here. The district's special attractions include the grand viewing platform Dubai Frame and Zabeel Park. The park can be considered a huge green oasis. There you will find dinosaur sculptures, illuminated gardens, an ice park with children's rides, barbecue pavilions, and a running track with non-slip coating and aroma diffuser. All these locations are within a 5-10 minute drive from the complex. It takes five minutes by car to reach Dubai's main highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, which runs along the coast. This highway provides quick access to any location in Dubai, as well as to the neighboring emirates of Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. The apartments in 1 Residences appeal to lovers of luxury and active lifestyles who want to enjoy comfort in a modern residential complex with unique architecture. The strategic proximity to the center of Dubai, business districts, and the airport highlights the convenience of living in 1 Residences.

This creates several ways to use the outdoor space while preserving the distinction between private and social rooms. Project visuals propose a tailored contemporary interior of warm timber, pale stone, restrained colour and layered lighting. Broad glazing draws the horizon into the principal rooms, while the sequence of kitchen, dining room, lounge, study and bedroom gives the property a genuine sense of residence within a five-star hotel. RAK Central places the hotel between Ras Al Khaimah's commercial centre and its resort corridor. Al Hamra Mall is approximately five minutes away, Al Hamra Golf Club seven minutes away, Al Marjan Island eight minutes away and Wynn Al Marjan Island around ten minutes away. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is approximately fifteen minutes away, while Dubai International Airport is around forty-five minutes away. Drive times are indicative and depend on traffic. description: Situated in DLRC next to Academic City, DLRC will be the prime Student Housing That will Pays 8-9% Gross Yields. Long stays: undergraduates usually stay 3-4 years, and 75-85% renew Parents back the lease: 80%+ of international student leases carry a parental guarantee Fewer missed payments: 2-4% default or late payment, against 8-12% for young professionals Staff and faculty tenants: 2-3 year contracts give income all year round Handling the summer gap: Start leases in September, line up next year's tenants in March-April, and allow summer sublets. This keeps June-August vacancies low. Why DLRC beats Dubai Silicon Oasis 20-30% cheaper to buy, which adds about 1-1.5 points of yield straight away Rents as high or higher (AED 60-65K against 58-62K) Room to grow: DLRC is still an emerging area, so prices have more room to rise than in mature DSO Metro coming: the Academic City station on the Dubai Metro Blue

title: LIVE ABOVE THE ORDINARY, SURROUNDED BY GREEN
raw_area: The Orchard Place Tower B, The Orchard Place, District 12, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
description:
Some places are built around buildings. Others are designed around the way you want to live.

In the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a contemporary European-inspired community rises with a different idea of urban living — one where architecture, greenery and everyday experiences come together to create a place that feels beautifully complete.

Imagine waking up to generous natural light, stepping onto your private terrace and beginning the day with your own quiet view of the community. With spacious residences, refined neutral interiors and terraces that can extend your living space outdoors, home becomes more than four walls. It becomes a private retreat within the city.

Then the day begins to unfold.

A 25-metre infinity pool with a submerged island invites you to swim, relax or simply let the afternoon disappear beside the water. The gym opens onto an outdoor area created for yoga, Pilates and moments of stillness, while the multifunctional paddle court adds energy whenever you feel like moving.

For evenings, the atmosphere changes.

Gather around one of the private barbecue spaces surrounded by landscaped greenery, meet friends in the dedicated meeting room, or simply take a quiet walk through the gardens as the lights begin to soften. Families have their own rhythm too, with a spacious kids club and outdoor cinema designed to give children a world of their own.

And then there is the rooftop.

For the select penthouses, expansive terraces and private swimming pools transform the highest levels into a more exclusive expression of life above the city. Here, the skyline becomes your backdrop, the terrace becomes your private outdoor room, and every sunset feels like an occasion.

With contemporary architecture, high ceilings, landscaped surroundings, concierge services and a location connected to Dubai's major roads and destinations, The Orchard Place brings together the things that matter most: space, comfort, connection and a sense of belonging.

description: New Project by Tarrad is an elegant mixed-use residential tower that blends contemporary architecture with a warm, welcoming sense of home. Its refined facade of soft cream stone, bronze-toned vertical fins and gently curved edges gives the building a graceful and instantly recognisable silhouette. Private balconies with sleek glass balustrades extend the living space outdoors and create a perfect spot to unwind. Warm neutral tones, premium stone and elegant bronze accents carry the building's refined character from the facade all the way inside, delivering a truly polished and sophisticated living experience. Location description and benefits Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world's largest container hubs, which has cemented the area's global significance in trade and commerce. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.
