title: Wadi Al Safa 3, Dubai
description: The Wilds Residences is a thoughtfully envisioned residential sanctuary that places nature at the very heart of everyday living. Created by Aldar, the project reimagines modern homes as spaces that restore balance, nurture wellbeing, and foster meaningful connections with the natural world. A curated collection of residences ranges from elegant one-bedroom homes to expansive family duplexes, all designed to blend refined architecture with the calming presence of greenery, water, and open skies. The community is enriched by a remarkable range of nature-led amenities that flow seamlessly through the landscape. Residents enjoy tranquil streams, nature-inspired pools, wellness and spa facilities, fitness zones, yoga decks, creative studios, family lounges, co-working spaces, and immersive outdoor experiences such as birdwatching, stargazing, cycling, and scenic trails. At the heart of the community, landscaped parks, adventure play areas, educational spaces, and social pavilions create a vibrant yet peaceful environment where families and individuals can truly flourish. Interiors are designed to reflect an elegant harmony between refined living and organic inspiration. Homes are bathed in natural light and finished with premium materials, offering a choice of light or dark interior palettes inspired by the natural landscape. Kitchens feature engineered stone countertops, contemporary cabinetry, and porcelain finishes, while bathrooms are appointed with high-quality ceramic sanitaryware and brushed bronze fittings. Flooring, wall treatments, and bespoke joinery combine durability with warmth, creating interiors that feel grounded, calming, and effortlessly sophisticate. Location Description and Benefits Wadi Al Safa 3 is an emerging area in the southern part of Dubai that offers a rare combination of tranquility and connectivity. Surrounded by established communities such as Majan and Al Barari, the area is defined by its openness, greenery, and sense of calm, making it particularly appealing for families and individuals seeking a more balanced lifestyle. Its setting allows residents to experience a quieter, nature-forward environment while remaining connected to the city's core. The area benefits from convenient access to major road networks, enabling smooth movement across Dubai and easy reach of key business, retail, and leisure destinations. This accessibility supports effortless daily routines while preserving a feeling of separation from dense urban congestion. The surrounding infrastructure continues to evolve, reinforcing the area's appeal as a long-term residential destination. With its emphasis on space, nature, and thoughtful urban planning, Wadi Al Safa 3 offers an environment that supports wellbeing and long-term livability. The district's proximity to green communities, combined with its strategic location within Dubai, makes it an attractive choice for those seeking a lifestyle shaped by calm, connection, and future growth.

Seamlessly linking a vibrant pedestrian boulevard, lush landscaped parks, and a world-class marina, it offers an exclusive lifestyle where city pace meets island calm. Built with smart home automation for lighting and climate control, the residences offer peak modern convenience. Sustainability is prioritized through energy-saving LED fixtures and high-efficiency VRF HVAC technology. description: Project general facts This is a contemporary residential development inspired by the timeless elegance of French architecture, where refined design meets modern comfort in a harmonious living environment. Thoughtfully crafted with graceful proportions, clean architectural lines, and beautifully landscaped surroundings, the project creates a peaceful sanctuary that balances sophistication with everyday functionality. Spacious residences are filled with natural light through open-plan layouts and expansive windows, offering bright, elegant interiors designed to foster comfort, tranquility, and a true sense of home. Residents enjoy a carefully curated collection of amenities that promote wellness, relaxation, and family living. Landscaped green spaces, walking paths, tranquil courtyards, a contemporary fitness center, meditation and recovery areas, and dedicated children's play zones create a vibrant community where every generation can thrive. Every element has been designed to encourage an active, balanced lifestyle while providing peaceful spaces for connection, recreation, and everyday wellbeing. The residences feature modern interiors finished with high-quality materials, elegant detailing, and integrated smart home technology that enhances comfort and convenience. Bright open spaces, bespoke storage solutions, and refined finishes create a timeless living environment that combines style with practicality. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered semi-furnished, offering built-in furniture and essential interior elements that provide the perfect foundation for personalized living. Location description and benefits Dubai South - is a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai. It serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities, designed with a vision to support the growth of various industries. One of its standout features is its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors. In addition to its logistical prowess, Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which served as a testament to the district's capacity to host large-scale global events. The Expo site has now transitioned into a legacy district, offering a wide range of amenities and infrastructure, including residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. Dubai South's commitment to sustainability is evident in its green initiatives, with a focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings. Dubai South continues to grow as a thriving business and residential hub, attracting both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for businesses and individuals alike, contributing to the ongoing development and economic diversification of Dubai. This district is celebrated as the first fully integrated walkable community in Sharjah. The design philosophy centers on a "car-free" environment at the ground level, prioritizing pedestrian safety, air quality, and social interaction. This zone does not exist in isolation; it is seamlessly abutted by two other distinct districts: Al Mamsha Souks and Al Mamsha Seerah. While the Souks offer a nod to traditional Arabian commerce and vibrant marketplaces, and Seerah focuses on residential tranquility and wellness, Raseel acts as the modern, high-tech core. Together, these three zones form a comprehensive ecosystem where residents can work, live, and play without ever needing to leave the neighborhood. Connectivity and Prime Location One of the most compelling features of this 1-bedroom apartment is its central location. Nama 3 offers residents a "best of both worlds" scenario: the cultural and educational richness of Sharjah paired with the commercial proximity of Dubai. Education and Commerce: The apartment is a mere 5 minutes away from University City of Sharjah, home to prestigious academic institutions, making it an ideal rental choice for faculty and graduate students. The Sharjah Industrial Area is also just 5 minutes away, catering to professionals working in the city's economic heart. Retail and Leisure: For premium shopping and dining, the 06 Mall is reachable within a 5-minute drive. If you are looking for green spaces, the lush Dubai National Park is just a 10-minute commute. Travel Hubs: Global connectivity is a breeze. Sharjah International Airport is only 10 minutes away, while Dubai International Airport (DXB) can be reached in approximately 15 minutes, making this a perfect residence for frequent travelers and international business professionals. Why Invest in Nama 3? The 1-bedroom units in Nama 3 are designed with the modern minimalist in mind, featuring open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light, and premium materials throughout. As Sharjah continues to grow as a cultural and economic powerhouse, properties within integrated communities like Al Mamsha Raseel are expected to see significant capital appreciation and high rental yields. Whether you are a first-time buyer looking for a stylish sanctuary or an investor eyeing the lucrative UAE real estate market, this apartment in Nama 3 offers a lifestyle defined by convenience, luxury, and connectivity. title: Mina Jebel Ali, Dubai
description: Raw District is a premium mixed-use development. Conceived as an "urban lifestyle philosophy" rather than a conventional residential project, the development is designed as a dynamic cultural hub where living, working, and social interaction seamlessly intersect. Its architecture embraces a raw, minimalistic aesthetic with open, adaptable spaces that prioritize functionality, movement, and continuous evolution.The project offers a wide range of fully furnished residences, including studios, 1- to 3-bedroom apartments, alongside office and retail spaces. Raw District stands out for its extensive and unconventional amenities, curated to foster creativity, collaboration, and community engagement. Rather than traditional leisure facilities, the project introduces concept-driven spaces such as creative studios, podcast rooms, co-working hubs, wellness zones, indoor and outdoor cinemas, and curated dining experiences. Signature features like the District Table, design labs, and maker spaces create an ecosystem where residents and professionals can connect, create, and evolve - forming a vibrant, ever-changing environment tailored to a new generation of urban living. Interiors follow a clean, stripped-back design language focused on efficiency and comfort, featuring open-plan kitchens, integrated appliances, smart storage solutions, and smart home technology. The layouts are thoughtfully designed to support modern urban lifestyles, balancing practicality with understated elegance. A strong emphasis is placed on furnishing and interior detailing, with residences delivered fully furnished in a refined, minimalist style that prioritizes clarity, usability, and quiet sophistication. Additional features such as acoustic treatments, smart home integration, and high-quality fittings further elevate everyday living, ensuring each space feels cohesive, functional, and effortlessly livable. Location description and benefits Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world's largest container hubs, which has cemented the area's global significance in trade and commerce. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.

raw_area: The Orchard Place Tower A, The Orchard Place, District 12, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
description:
Some places are built around buildings. Others are designed around the way you want to live.

In the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a contemporary European-inspired community rises with a different idea of urban living — one where architecture, greenery and everyday experiences come together to create a place that feels beautifully complete.

Imagine waking up to generous natural light, stepping onto your private terrace and beginning the day with your own quiet view of the community. With spacious residences, refined neutral interiors and terraces that can extend your living space outdoors, home becomes more than four walls. It becomes a private retreat within the city.

Then the day begins to unfold.

A 25-metre infinity pool with a submerged island invites you to swim, relax or simply let the afternoon disappear beside the water. The gym opens onto an outdoor area created for yoga, Pilates and moments of stillness, while the multifunctional paddle court adds energy whenever you feel like moving.

For evenings, the atmosphere changes.

Gather around one of the private barbecue spaces surrounded by landscaped greenery, meet friends in the dedicated meeting room, or simply take a quiet walk through the gardens as the lights begin to soften. Families have their own rhythm too, with a spacious kids club and outdoor cinema designed to give children a world of their own.

And then there is the rooftop.

For the select penthouses, expansive terraces and private swimming pools transform the highest levels into a more exclusive expression of life above the city. Here, the skyline becomes your backdrop, the terrace becomes your private outdoor room, and every sunset feels like an occasion.

With contemporary architecture, high ceilings, landscaped surroundings, concierge services and a location connected to Dubai's major roads and destinations, The Orchard Place brings together the things that matter most: space, comfort, connection and a sense of belonging.

description: Reference: UAJM-T3278. 1 Bed Apartment for Sale in Nama 3 Complex Sharjah UAE Esales Property ID: es5554971 Al Mamsha Alef - Muwaileh Commercial - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates AED 800,000 Luxury Living Reimagined: Premium 1-Bedroom Apartment in Nama 3, Sharjah Discover the epitome of modern urban living with this exquisite 1-bedroom apartment for sale in the Nama 3 Complex, a prestigious residential landmark currently rising in the heart of the Emirate of Sharjah. Positioned within the highly anticipated Al Mamsha Raseel development, Nama 3 represents a sophisticated blend of contemporary architecture, high-end finishing, and an unparalleled lifestyle proposition. For those seeking an investment or a home in one of the UAE's most forward-thinking districts, this property offers a unique entry point into a vibrant, future-proof community. The Concept: Sharjah's Premier Walkable Community Nama 3 is located within Zone 3 of Al Mamsha Raseel, a visionary project designed by the Alef Group. This district is celebrated as the first fully integrated walkable community in Sharjah. The design philosophy centers on a 'car-free' environment at the ground level, prioritizing pedestrian safety, air quality, and social interaction. Imagine stepping out of your luxury tower directly onto beautifully landscaped walkways, where high-end retail stores, artisanal cafes, and essential services are all within a few minutes' stroll. This layout creates a harmonious balance between the privacy of residential life and the energy of a bustling commercial hub. A Strategic Masterplan: Al Mamsha Raseel The Al Mamsha Raseel sector is strategically nestled along the E311 (Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road), the primary artery connecting the various Emirates. This zone does not exist in isolation; it is seamlessly abutted by two other distinct districts: Al Mamsha Souks and Al Mamsha Seerah. While the Souks offer a nod to traditional Arabian commerce and vibrant marketplaces, and Seerah focuses on residential tranquility and wellness, Raseel acts as the modern, high-tech core. title: 78XC+35, Dubai
description: Samana Ocean Bay is a contemporary waterfront development that brings together modern architecture, coastal-inspired design, and resort-style living. Inspired by the natural movement of the sea and the openness of the sky, its distinctive curved architecture, luminous façade, and elegant coastal textures create a serene and sophisticated atmosphere. Set within the Dubai Islands destination, Ocean Bay offers a lifestyle shaped by the beauty of the waterfront and the comforts of modern residential living. Amenities and lifestyle Designed around wellness, relaxation, and recreation, Samana Ocean Bay offers a diverse range of lifestyle amenities. Residents can enjoy a fully equipped gym, outdoor fitness areas, meditation zones, a tranquil Zen garden, and a steam room, complemented by landscaped green spaces. The development features an infinity-edge swimming pool, a children's pool, splash areas, and outdoor playgrounds, creating opportunities for relaxation and family-friendly recreation. Together, these facilities deliver a resort-inspired atmosphere where residents can unwind, stay active, and enjoy leisure within their own community. Interiors and finishes Each residence is thoughtfully designed to maximise natural light, space, and comfort. Spacious layouts, high ceilings, and large windows create bright interiors while enhancing the connection between indoor living spaces and the surrounding waterfront setting. Premium materials, carefully selected colour palettes, refined finishes, and ambient lighting contribute to an elegant and welcoming atmosphere. Private infinity pools in the residences, along with spa-inspired bathrooms, add an extra dimension of exclusivity and relaxation. Kitchen and appliances Fully equipped kitchens featuring Bosch appliances, combining modern functionality with everyday convenience. Furnishing Semi-furnished, offering a stylish foundation that residents can personalise to suit their preferences. Location and lifestyle Located on Central Island within Dubai Islands, Samana Ocean Bay is part of a distinctive waterfront destination designed to combine coastal living with contemporary urban convenience. The wider development comprises five islands, with plans for residential communities, beachfront experiences, hospitality venues, retail destinations, and leisure facilities. The island setting offers a more relaxed atmosphere, with access to beaches, landscaped spaces, and waterfront activities. Road connections to mainland Dubai provide access to the city's established business districts, shopping destinations, and entertainment hubs, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. With its coastal surroundings, resort-inspired amenities, and contemporary residences, Samana Ocean Bay offers an appealing choice for buyers seeking a waterfront lifestyle that balances tranquillity, modern comfort, and access to Dubai's wider attractions.

At Native Haus, that difference begins the moment you arrive.

Set within the quiet, low-density surroundings of Jumeirah Village Triangle, Native Haus introduces a boutique approach to contemporary living — one designed around the way modern life truly moves. Only 162 residences make up this intimate six-storey address.

Inside, studios, one-bedroom residences with study spaces, and two-bedroom homes with study areas are designed with intelligent layouts, contemporary interiors and three-metre ceilings. Every residence also comes with its own private deck — creating a natural transition between the warmth of your interior and the openness beyond it.

Then the building opens into its own world.

Outdoor cinema evenings.
Jogging and calisthenics areas.
Pickleball.
A gaming lounge.
Co-working spaces and a Creator's Club.

More than 10,000 sq. ft. of amenities have been designed around one simple idea: your home should support every version of you.

And when you step outside, JVT keeps the city within reach.

With Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road just minutes away, and Al Khail Avenue Mall nearby, Native Haus gives you the rare balance of a peaceful residential setting without sacrificing connectivity.

This is not about living bigger.

It is about living better.

A private deck.
A thoughtful home.
A connected neighbourhood.

title: Union Takaya
description:
Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It combines three towers: Takaya Tower rises 29 floors above ground, basement and podium levels, while Symphony and Harmony each have 19. Townhouses and villas sit around a shared podium, for a total of 744 apartments, 39 townhouses and five villas plus retail units. Apartments run from studios to four bedrooms, with one- to four-bedroom layouts of 831 sq ft to 2,339 sq ft, and the four-bedroom townhouses are set over three levels with a roof terrace.

Homes are handed over semi-furnished, with soft pastel interiors and kitchens fitted with Siemens appliances; many layouts add a maid's room and walk-in wardrobes. The 24 shared amenities include lap, recreational and children's pools, three gyms, two squash courts, a paddle tennis court, a golf simulator, a cinema room, co-working spaces, a children's day care and a sky garden. Parking is provided for 1,203 cars, 100 of them enabled for EV charging. A landscaped retail plaza sits at street level, and Motor City's gardens, cycle paths and the Dubai Outdoor Kartdrome are nearby.

Union Properties, founded in 1987 and publicly listed, is the developer behind Motor City, Dubai Autodrome and Uptown Mirdif, and has delivered more than 10,000 units in Dubai. Takaya adds a broad spread of apartment sizes and a limited number of townhouses and villas to this established community between major highways. The payment plan asks for 5% on booking and 15% during construction, with the remaining 80% due on handover, expected in Q4 2027.

description:
WHERE THE LAGOON BECOMES PART OF HOME
 

Some homes give you a beautiful view.

Others give you a completely different way of living.

Lunaya Terraces belongs to the second kind.

Set within the nature-led world of Lunaya in Jebel Ali, this refined collection of low-rise residences brings a new expression of waterfront living to Dubai. Here, architecture rises gently around water, gardens and open skies, creating a home that feels connected to nature from every angle.

The experience begins with the terraces.

Generous private outdoor spaces extend the living room beyond its walls, while floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light deep into the interiors. With one-, two- and three-bedroom residences, Lunaya Terraces combines contemporary elegance with the openness and privacy usually associated with villa living.

Then there is the landscape.

A remarkable 900,000 sq. ft. of swimmable lagoons forms the heart of Lunaya, surrounded by greenery and connected through walking and cycling routes. Around the terraces, the lifestyle unfolds through rooftop pools, wellness spaces, fitness facilities, gardens, children's areas, sports courts, cafés and everyday conveniences.

Imagine starting your morning with sunlight across your terrace.

A swim beside the lagoon.

An afternoon spent between wellness and greenery.

And an evening where the water becomes the backdrop to everything.

This is the beauty of Lunaya Terraces.

Not apartment living as you know it.

A more open, more natural and more refined way to experience home.

Where the terrace becomes your outdoor room.
Where the lagoon becomes your horizon.
And where every day feels beautifully connected to nature.

Location Description & Benefits Dubai Maritime City is a distinctive waterfront destination that combines maritime infrastructure, commercial activity, and emerging residential developments. Strategically positioned near Dubai's established urban districts and major port facilities, the area is evolving into a specialised maritime hub while introducing new opportunities for waterfront living. The district has traditionally supported a wide range of marine-related industries, including shipbuilding, vessel maintenance, marine engineering, and maritime services. Its infrastructure includes specialised shipyards, dry docks, and facilities for marine equipment and service providers, alongside educational and training institutions that support the maritime sector. Its strategic position near Dubai's key ports and transport networks provides important connectivity for maritime businesses and international trade. At the same time, its proximity to the city's established districts allows residents and professionals to benefit from access to commercial centres, retail destinations, dining, and everyday conveniences. As Dubai Maritime City continues to develop, the combination of its waterfront setting, specialised commercial infrastructure, and growing residential offering is creating a distinctive urban environment. It presents an interesting proposition for those seeking a contemporary lifestyle within a developing coastal destination, supported by its strategic position within Dubai.

description: Golf Trails by Emaar Properties is a contemporary residential development located within the prestigious Emaar South community in Dubai. Inspired by the natural beauty of its surroundings, the development features elegant modern architecture that blends seamlessly with the lush landscapes of the Emaar South Golf Course. Offering a selection of thoughtfully designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, Golf Trails combines spacious layouts, refined interiors, and a peaceful residential setting to create an ideal living environment for individuals and families. The architectural design reflects a sophisticated balance between contemporary aesthetics and natural elements, with earthy tones and elegant detailing that complement the surrounding greenery. Designed to promote an active yet relaxed lifestyle, the development offers an extensive range of amenities, including an infinity swimming pool, children's swimming pool, sports courts, landscaped open lawns, and a fully equipped fitness center. Residents can also enjoy dedicated children's play areas, multipurpose spaces, and beautifully designed outdoor leisure areas, creating opportunities for recreation, relaxation, and community engagement. The interiors are thoughtfully crafted with high-quality materials, contemporary finishes, and a warm, neutral colour palette that creates a calming and welcoming atmosphere. Open-plan layouts maximize space and natural light, while modern kitchens feature stylish fittings and contemporary appliances. Luxuriously finished bathrooms, carefully selected materials, and elegant detailing further enhance the overall residential experience. Every element is designed to provide comfort, functionality, and timeless appeal. Location Description & Benefits Located within Emaar South, Golf Trails enjoys a strategic position in one of Dubai's emerging residential and golf communities. Emaar South is a master-planned development designed around modern living, landscaped green spaces, and an integrated community lifestyle. Its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport and major economic hubs makes it an attractive destination for residents seeking connectivity, convenience, and long-term growth potential. The community benefits from convenient access to major destinations, including Expo City Dubai, Dubai South, and Dubai Marina, while its connectivity to key road networks allows residents to travel efficiently across Dubai and the wider UAE. The nearby Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club further enhances the area's recreational appeal, offering additional leisure and sporting experiences. One of the community's most distinctive features is the Emaar South Golf Course, which provides a picturesque green backdrop and an exceptional lifestyle experience for golf enthusiasts. Residents can enjoy beautifully landscaped surroundings, outdoor recreational spaces, and a peaceful atmosphere away from the city's busy urban environment. Emaar South is designed as a self-sufficient residential community, offering a comprehensive range of everyday facilities, including community parks, retail outlets, dining options, educational facilities, and a mosque. The planned school district and family-oriented amenities make it particularly appealing to families seeking a convenient and well-connected residential environment. With its golf-course surroundings, contemporary residences, extensive lifestyle amenities, and strategic location near Dubai's expanding southern growth corridor, Golf Trails presents an attractive opportunity for both end-users and investors looking for quality living and future potential in Dubai.

description: Chelsea Residences by DAMAC is an exceptional waterfront development in Dubai Maritime City, bringing together contemporary architecture, refined coastal living, and world-class lifestyle experiences. Comprising six distinctive towers delivered across two phases, the development presents an exclusive collection of one, two, and three-bedroom residences designed to complement modern urban lifestyles. With elegant architectural details, sophisticated interiors, and panoramic sea views, it offers a unique residential experience in one of Dubai's emerging waterfront destinations. The development features an impressive selection of wellness, leisure, and sports-inspired amenities designed to create a resort-style atmosphere. Residents can enjoy infinity swimming pools, aerial yoga spaces, jogging tracks, outdoor fitness facilities, and dedicated wellness experiences, including cryotherapy, water treatment tunnels, rain therapy areas, and forest relaxation pods. Additional attractions include a Chelsea Football simulation room, underwater-themed children's play areas, and the exclusive Chelsea Blue Beach Club, bringing together recreation, relaxation, and sporting culture in one vibrant community. Every residence is finished with carefully selected materials that balance durability with contemporary elegance. Porcelain-tiled flooring, painted plastered walls, gypsum ceilings, and double-glazed windows create a refined and comfortable living environment, while balconies are provided according to the individual layouts. Fully fitted kitchens include a refrigerator, cooker, hood, washing machine, and reverse osmosis water filtration system. Semi-furnished residences feature built-in wardrobes where applicable, offering practical functionality alongside modern design. Combining waterfront views, distinctive architecture, and an extensive range of lifestyle amenities, this development offers a sophisticated residential experience where coastal tranquillity meets the energy of Dubai's urban landscape. Location Description and Benefits Dubai Maritime City is a distinctive waterfront district strategically positioned near Dubai's historic commercial areas and major maritime infrastructure. Developed as a specialised hub for the maritime industry, the district brings together marine services, shipbuilding, vessel maintenance, and supporting commercial activities within a dedicated environment. The area features specialised facilities, including shipyards, dry docks, marine equipment suppliers, and maritime service zones. Educational and professional training facilities further contribute to its role as a centre for maritime expertise, supporting industry development and innovation. Alongside its commercial significance, the district's waterfront setting adds to its appeal as an emerging location for contemporary residential developments. Its strategic position provides convenient road access to established parts of Dubai, including Port Rashid, Downtown Dubai, and the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). Connections to major transport routes and nearby port facilities also support access to key commercial districts and international trade networks. Dubai Maritime City's combination of waterfront surroundings, commercial importance, and connectivity makes it an increasingly distinctive part of Dubai's urban landscape. For residents, the location offers the appeal of coastal living alongside access to the city's business, dining, retail, and entertainment destinations.

description: Project general facts Interstellar Tower is a visionary addition to the urban skyline, distinguished by its sleek futuristic architecture and bold contemporary design. Located in a prime area, the development embodies innovation and modern elegance, creating a striking architectural landmark. Its thoughtfully designed residences feature spacious layouts, expansive windows, and sophisticated interiors that maximize natural light while delivering a harmonious balance of comfort, style, and functionality. Residents enjoy a carefully curated selection of lifestyle amenities, including a panoramic infinity pool, landscaped sky garden, dedicated wellness and fitness facilities, coworking spaces, and inviting community areas. Together, these amenities create a vibrant environment where relaxation, productivity, and social connection come together to enhance everyday living. Each residence features stylish interiors that combine contemporary design with natural materials, complemented by premium lighting from Zonda Lighting. The apartments include fully fitted kitchens equipped with Bosch appliances and are delivered with built-in wardrobes and cabinetry by Fabel Casa, providing elegant, functional living spaces ready for everyday comfort. Location description and benefits Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT) is a well-planned residential district in Dubai that seamlessly blends tranquility with convenience. The neighborhood features a mix of villas, townhouses, and apartments surrounded by lush landscaping and parks. The circular layout of JVT ensures easy navigation, while the ample green spaces provide a peaceful retreat for residents seeking a serene lifestyle away from the city's hustle and bustle. JVT offers a wide array of amenities, catering to both families and individuals. The community includes schools, supermarkets, healthcare facilities, and fitness centers, ensuring that all daily needs are met within a short distance. Its numerous parks, jogging tracks, and cycling paths encourage an active lifestyle, while the vibrant community center and retail outlets provide spaces for shopping and socializing. Conveniently located near major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, JVT offers excellent connectivity to Dubai's key destinations, including Dubai Marina, JBR, and Downtown Dubai. Designed with a focus on blending modern architecture with natural surroundings, JVT features thoughtfully planned infrastructure, emphasizing sustainability and livability. Water features and landscaped gardens add to the charm of this tranquil community, making it an ideal choice for those looking to enjoy modern conveniences in a peaceful, green setting. Whether you're looking for a family-oriented community or a relaxing space to call home, JVT offers the perfect balance of lifestyle and location.

title: 78Q2+2Q, Dubai
description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

description: Portside Square is a distinctive waterfront development set within the historic Mina Rashid, where contemporary architecture takes inspiration from the movement and rhythm of the sea. Comprising three sculptural towers - Portside Residences I, II, and III - the development is characterised by fluid lines, soft contours, and shimmering façades that interact beautifully with natural light. Its architectural design creates a harmonious relationship between sea, sky, and structure, offering a refined residential environment with open layouts, expansive glazing, and panoramic views. The development presents a lifestyle centred around wellness, leisure, and social connection. Residents can enjoy leisure and lap pools, landscaped decks, a dedicated fitness pavilion, and spa and sauna facilities. Additional amenities include yoga areas, co-working spaces, cinema and games lounges, and a dedicated children's club, creating an environment that caters to different lifestyles and age groups. Outdoor spaces are thoughtfully integrated throughout the community, with jogging paths, landscaped garden courtyards, and marina-facing lounges offering inviting places to relax, exercise, and connect. The combination of wellness facilities, recreational spaces, and social areas creates a balanced lifestyle with a distinct waterfront character. The residences feature contemporary interiors finished with high-quality materials, natural textures, and refined detailing. Equipped kitchens incorporate premium appliances, combining modern functionality with elegant design. Delivered unfurnished, the homes offer residents the flexibility to personalise their interiors while benefiting from a sophisticated architectural foundation and carefully selected finishes. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Maritime City is a distinctive waterfront destination that combines maritime infrastructure, commercial activity, and emerging residential developments. Strategically positioned near Dubai's established urban districts and major port facilities, the area is evolving into a specialised maritime hub while introducing new opportunities for waterfront living. The district has traditionally supported a wide range of marine-related industries, including shipbuilding, vessel maintenance, marine engineering, and maritime services. Its infrastructure includes specialised shipyards, dry docks, and facilities for marine equipment and service providers, alongside educational and training institutions that support the maritime sector. Its strategic position near Dubai's key ports and transport networks provides important connectivity for maritime businesses and international trade. At the same time, its proximity to the city's established districts allows residents and professionals to benefit from access to commercial centres, retail destinations, dining, and everyday conveniences. As Dubai Maritime City continues to develop, the combination of its waterfront setting, specialised commercial infrastructure, and growing residential offering is creating a distinctive urban environment. It presents an interesting proposition for those seeking a contemporary lifestyle within a developing coastal destination, supported by its strategic position within Dubai.

title: Damac Chic Tower
description:
Chic Tower is a DAMAC development in Business Bay, set on the Dubai Canal. The tower rises from a ground floor and five podium levels through 36 residential floors to a stepped roof, with undulating terraces that take their shape from the canal's waves. Its turquoise theme reflects the aesthetic of jeweller de GRISOGONO. The building holds around 450 homes: studios from 411 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments from 610 sq ft, two-bedroom apartments from 1,145 sq ft and a handful of three- and four-bedroom residences starting at 4,998 sq ft.

Homes are delivered unfurnished with fully equipped kitchens. The three- and four-bedroom units each have a planted terrace with an infinity pool, a personal gym and a projection screen. Wellness shapes the shared spaces: the lobby has workout benches and weights, and the podium holds seven baths, including hot, cold, salt and mud baths, a spa, a beauty bar and an outdoor calisthenics gym. Pools, cabanas, a juice bar, playgrounds, football pitches, party areas and a 180-metre lazy river complete it. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and DIFC are close by, and Dubai International Airport is about a 15-minute drive.

Business Bay and Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall metro stations are both nearby. The tower includes just three three-bedroom homes and one four-bedroom home. DAMAC, active in the region since 2002, reported around 42,000 homes delivered as of December 2021. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q4 2026. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department, with its escrow account held at Mashreq Bank.

description: Beachfront Apartments with Post-Handover Payment Plan on Al Marjan Island Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah, stretching 4.5 kilometers into the Arabian Gulf and offering over 7 kilometers of white-sand beaches and 23 kilometers of waterfront promenade. Comprising four coral-shaped islands, Breeze, Treasure, Dream, and View, it is home to luxury resorts, beach clubs, water sports, and world-class hospitality brands like Rixos, Mövenpick, and DoubleTree. With upcoming landmark developments such as Nobu and the Wynn Resort, Al Marjan Island is rapidly emerging as a premier destination for waterfront living, tourism, and high-return real estate investment, just 45 minutes from Dubai. , are ideally located just 2 minutes from Wynn Resort, 12 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 13 minutes from RAK Central, 14 minutes from Al Hamra Golf Club, 16 minutes from the Royal Yacht Club of Ras Al Khaimah, 30 minutes from RAK Mall and Al Qawasim Corniche, 35 minutes from RAK International Airport, 50 minutes from Sharjah International Airport, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai. The project rises 16 storeys above the Arabian Gulf on Al Marjan Island, designed as a sculptural icon that cascades organically towards the sea, blending architecture with nature to create an exclusive waterfront sanctuary. Its bold yet fluid form is complemented by lush tropical landscaping and flowing water features that embrace a serene promenade. At its core, this development offers a curated lifestyle of wellness and luxury, with world-class amenities such as a state-of-the-art gym, yoga studio, infinity pool, children's pool, padel court, jogging track, family lawn, and scenic garden spaces. Residents are welcomed through a grand arrival drop-off and a striking residential lobby, with direct access to retail outlets at the ground level. Thoughtfully designed terraces and curved balconies frame uninterrupted panoramic sea views and golden sunsets, while tranquil zones like the activity lawn, sunken seating areas, and waterscapes foster relaxation and community. The architectural layout integrates seamlessly with its environment. This destination is just minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort and key Ras Al Khaimah attractions, positioning it as a prime address for upscale living and future investment. The project presents a refined collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, meticulously designed to blend contemporary luxury with serene coastal living. Each apartment features thoughtfully planned layouts with generous living spaces, high ceilings, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the interiors with natural light while offering sweeping views of the sea. The design palette embodies understated elegance, featuring soft neutral tones, premium finishes, and the incorporation of natural materials like stone to create a calm, organic ambiance. Residences come with fully fitted kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods, as well as built-in wardrobes that maximize storage while maintaining sleek, modern aesthetics. Spacious balconies extend the living areas outdoors, enhancing the connection to nature and creating private sanctuaries for relaxation. The interiors are a harmonious balance of functionality and style, crafted to deliver comfort, sophistication, and a lifestyle rooted in both beauty and practicality. RKT-00021

title: Prescott Legado
description:
Legado by Prescott is a residential tower by Prescott in JVC (Jumeirah Village Circle). It rises 34 storeys, with two basements, a ground floor and five podium levels below 26 residential floors, behind a sleek glass facade. The building holds 343 homes: studios, one-bedroom apartments, two- and three-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, and two- and three-bedroom sky villas. One-bedroom apartments start from 803 sq ft, and two-bedroom apartments range from 1,493 to 1,543 sq ft.

Homes have open-plan layouts with floor-to-ceiling windows, smart home technology and fitted kitchens, and the one-bedroom layout includes two bathrooms. The lobby offers a lounge with 24/7 concierge and valet services. Facilities are spread across three floors: a kids' splash park, kids' pool, kids' basketball court and jogging track on the first floor; a clubhouse, library, co-working hub, fitness studio, multilevel cinema and coffee bar on the 14th floor; and a 35-metre infinity pool, sunbathing deck, cabanas, table tennis and meditation decks on the 24th floor. Circle Mall is about 10 minutes away, and Hessa Street, Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road are all close by.

The project suits buyers looking for a family-oriented tower in JVC with a broad set of shared facilities. Prescott has been active in Dubai since 2006 and has delivered projects such as Prime Residency and Prime Views. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q1 2028.

title: Ras Al Khor, Dubai
description: Project general facts Sanctuary is a refined residential development set within the prestigious Meydan district, uniquely positioned beside the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The project's architecture reflects modern sophistication, with a sculpted façade of glass and clean geometry designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views. Sanctuary offers a rare balance between urban elegance and nature, providing residents with uninterrupted vistas of the Dubai skyline and protected natural landscapes, while remaining minutes from Downtown Dubai and major city arteries. The project features an extensive collection of resort-style amenities thoughtfully distributed across dedicated lifestyle levels. Residents enjoy landscaped serenity gardens, waterfall features, sunken island pools, infinity pools, outdoor fitness areas, kids' pools and play zones, BBQ areas, outdoor cinema, jacuzzi, spa-style relaxation pools, and sky gardens with observation decks. Indoor amenities include a state-of-the-art gym, sauna, indoor cinema, games area, and family-friendly communal spaces, creating a holistic living environment focused on wellness, leisure, and community. Interiors at Sanctuary are designed to reflect calm, comfort, and contemporary luxury. Living spaces are bright and spacious, enhanced by large windows that frame natural and skyline views. The residences are delivered without furniture, and interior specifications follow a standard of high-quality finishes with modern materials, aligned with the project's premium positioning. The overall interior concept emphasizes timeless design, functional layouts, and a serene atmosphere that complements the project's nature-inspired setting. Location description and benefits Ras Al Khor is one of Dubai's hidden gems, where urban convenience meets the untouched beauty of nature. Located just minutes from the city's bustling center, this district is best known for the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a protected reserve that is home to thousands of migratory birds, including the iconic pink flamingos. The area's unique charm lies in its serene landscapes, offering residents and visitors a peaceful retreat from the dynamic energy of Dubai while still being well-connected to major landmarks and attractions. Beyond its natural wonders, Ras Al Khor is an emerging residential and commercial hub, offering a blend of modern infrastructure and tranquil surroundings. The district features a mix of upscale developments, spacious villas, and waterfront residences, all designed to provide a harmonious balance between luxury and sustainability. With easy access to Dubai Creek, Downtown Dubai, and major road networks, Ras Al Khor ensures a seamless lifestyle that combines convenience with scenic beauty. As Dubai continues to grow, Ras Al Khor remains a testament to the city's commitment to preserving its natural heritage while embracing modern progress. Future developments in the area promise to enhance its appeal with new residential communities, leisure destinations, and cultural attractions. Whether you are drawn to its stunning wildlife sanctuary, its picturesque waterfront views, or its growing urban landscape, Ras Al Khor offers a unique living experience where nature and city life coexist in perfect harmony.

title: LIVE ABOVE THE WATER, SURROUNDED BY NATURE
raw_area: Cove at Lunaya Terraces, Lunaya Terraces, Saih Shuaib 1, Jebel Ali, Dubai
description:
WHERE THE LAGOON BECOMES PART OF HOME
 

Some homes give you a beautiful view.

Others give you a completely different way of living.

Lunaya Terraces belongs to the second kind.

Set within the nature-led world of Lunaya in Jebel Ali, this refined collection of low-rise residences brings a new expression of waterfront living to Dubai. Here, architecture rises gently around water, gardens and open skies, creating a home that feels connected to nature from every angle.

The experience begins with the terraces.

Generous private outdoor spaces extend the living room beyond its walls, while floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light deep into the interiors. With one-, two- and three-bedroom residences, Lunaya Terraces combines contemporary elegance with the openness and privacy usually associated with villa living.

Then there is the landscape.

A remarkable 900,000 sq. ft. of swimmable lagoons forms the heart of Lunaya, surrounded by greenery and connected through walking and cycling routes. Around the terraces, the lifestyle unfolds through rooftop pools, wellness spaces, fitness facilities, gardens, children's areas, sports courts, cafés and everyday conveniences.

Imagine starting your morning with sunlight across your terrace.

A swim beside the lagoon.

An afternoon spent between wellness and greenery.

And an evening where the water becomes the backdrop to everything.

This is the beauty of Lunaya Terraces.

Not apartment living as you know it.

A more open, more natural and more refined way to experience home.

Where the terrace becomes your outdoor room.
Where the lagoon becomes your horizon.
And where every day feels beautifully connected to nature.

One of the district's key advantages is its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, which forms a central part of Dubai's long-term aviation and logistics ambitions. Portside Square is developed by Ellington in Mina Rashid, a historic port district that opened in 1972 and now includes a marina and cruise terminal. Its 408 homes range from studios of 396 sq ft to four-bedroom penthouses of 3,441 sq ft, with one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom units with a study in between.

Apartments are delivered with equipped kitchens and are otherwise unfurnished. Studios and one- and two-bedroom homes come with one parking space, and three- and four-bedroom homes with two. A first-floor amenity deck has a leisure pool, a kids' pool, cabanas, a running track, an outdoor fitness area and gardens. The pavilion adds a cinema and games lounge, an arcade, co-working pods, a spa with saunas and hot and cold plunge pools, yoga and Pilates areas, a fitness studio with a juice bar and a clubhouse. The Queen Elizabeth 2 is about a minute's drive away, Sheikh Zayed Road six minutes, and Downtown Dubai, Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International Airport around 10 minutes.

The location links Mina Rashid's maritime heritage with short drives to the city's business districts, including DIFC at about 14 minutes. Homes are offered on a freehold basis, and the project is registered with the Dubai Land Department. The payment plan asks for 20% on booking, 50% during construction and 30% on handover, with completion expected in Q4 2029.

description: Project general facts This is a premium waterfront residential development rising on Dubai Islands, where contemporary architecture meets the calm rhythm of the sea. Designed with refined coastal tones and fluid façades, the project reflects a modern interpretation of island living, defined by openness, light, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Low-density planning enhances privacy and exclusivity, while landscaped gardens and open lounges create a resort-style ambiance shaped by nature and horizon views. The lifestyle is centered around wellness, leisure, and effortless sophistication. Residents are welcomed through a dedicated VIP drop-off area and enjoy access to an extensive collection of curated amenities, including adult and children's swimming pools, a pavilion clubhouse, outdoor yoga and wellness zones, jogging and walking tracks, mixed landscape gardens with sand and gravel concepts, grand tiered seating areas, covered lounges, and open-to-sky garden seating. From cascading water features to outdoor cinema and relaxation decks, every space is designed to evoke a refined island retreat atmosphere. The residences are delivered fully furnished and fully designed, incorporating a smart home system and refined interior detailing accessorized by Hermès. Layouts are bright and airy, emphasizing natural light and a smooth transition between interior and exterior spaces. Duplex residences feature elevated privacy and, in select units, private pools, enhancing the exclusive waterfront experience. Sea Cliff by Imtiaz represents a harmonious blend of architectural elegance, intelligent living, and curated luxury in a serene island setting. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.
